name: Gareth

attributes.attribute: son of Morgause and king Lot of Orkney
named Beaumains by Kay for his beautiful hands

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gareth, called Gareth of Orkney, was an Arthurian hero. He also bore the names Beaumains and Gaheriet. He was the nephew of king Arthur. His mother was Morgause, the half-sister of Arthur. His father was king Lot of Orkney. Gareth was a minor hero of Arthurian romance. His hands were so beautiful that Kay named him Beaumains. The name means beautiful hands. Lancelot killed Gareth by accident. Lancelot was fighting to save queen Guinevere from the executioner's flames.

okr.objective: Record Gareth as a minor Arthurian hero and nephew of king Arthur.
